There are some mods that create meta subs for discussing the state or plans/ideas for a sub - usually in the form of /v/subnamemeta - in order to keep the sub itself free from meta-discussion. Maybe instead of having mods create entirely new subs for this, just have a built-in meta for each sub (e.g. /v/subname/meta or /meta/subname). This would keep mods from having to set up new subs just for meta discussion, and will automatically provide a place for meta discussion if people wish to do that.

Another feature for this would be to allow the mod of a sub to move meta discussions from the main sub itself to the meta if they so wish (e.g. move meta threads from /v/subname to /v/subname/meta). Maybe even include a link to the Meta in the "Hot, New, Top" link bar.

You could do it with a simple flag in the database for a submission. You're not creating a entirely new sub, you're just flagging submissions as meta and having them appear in the meta section. Posts made in the meta section, or moved to the meta section, will have this flag set. It's nothing more than a boolean value and a little extra code. No extra bloat needed. And as I mentioned, it doesn't have to be used.
